name: Guizhou Guihang Automotive Components Co.,Ltd
summary: Guizhou Guihang Automotive Components Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of automotive parts in China and internationally. The company offers aluminum water radiators, oil coolers, intercoolers, blower heater assemblies, and CPU radiators; car air, filter elements, oil and fuel filters; heaters, and condensers, evaporators, and other products. It also provides electric wipers and window regulators; combination switches, power window switches, and other switches; door lock mechanisms; lock cylinder assemblies, ignition switches, door handles, and fuel filler caps/holders.
